senses.zh: 把（自己、一生等）献给（to）；为（建筑物等）举行落成典礼

en.v: himself body and soul to the education of young people.

examples.zh: 他全身心地投入到年轻人的教育中。

errata.original: He dedicated himself body and soul to the education of young people.
